feed.title: Web & Frontend — Useful Sites
feed.subtitle: An annotated directory of links on software, AI, security and science. Every entry states what the resource does and where it parts ways with its neighbours.

entry.title: Atmos
entry.summary: Everything needed to create colour palettes, with accessibility checks.

entry.title: Autoprefixer
entry.summary: A tool that automatically adds browser prefixes (‑webkit‑, ‑moz‑) to CSS. Unlike adding them by hand it knows which prefix is needed from current browser data.

entry.title: Awesome Angular
entry.summary: A list of components, tools and tutorials for the Angular application framework. Unlike the official docs it gathers community libraries and real examples.

entry.title: Awesome CSS
entry.summary: A list gathering the CSS language, tools and resources by topic.

entry.title: Awesome CSS Learning
entry.summary: A resource list focused on learning the CSS language and its modules.

entry.title: Awesome Frontend GIS
entry.summary: A list of libraries for geographic information systems (maps) in the browser.

entry.title: Awesome HTML5
entry.summary: A list of HTML5 APIs, tools and resources.

entry.title: Awesome Mobile Web Development
entry.summary: A resource list for building a great mobile web experience.

entry.title: Awesome PostCSS
entry.summary: A resource list for PostCSS, the tool that transforms CSS with plugins.

entry.title: Awesome Preact
entry.summary: A resource list for Preact, the lightweight React alternative.

entry.title: Awesome React
entry.summary: A list of libraries, tools and learning resources for the React ecosystem.

entry.title: Awesome React Hooks
entry.summary: A list of libraries and examples for React Hooks.

entry.title: Awesome Svelte
entry.summary: A list of components and tools for Svelte and SvelteKit. Unlike React-heavy lists it shows the ecosystem specific to this compile-time framework.

entry.title: Awesome Tailwind CSS
entry.summary: A list of plugins, components and tools for Tailwind CSS.

entry.title: Awesome WebExtensions
entry.summary: A resource list for building cross-browser add-ons (WebExtensions). Unlike single-browser docs it focuses on the common API that works across Chrome, Firefox and Safari.

entry.title: Awwwards
entry.summary: A gallery that awards and showcases outstanding web design. Unlike random inspiration it filters quality through jury evaluation.

entry.title: Bootstrap
entry.summary: The most widely used CSS framework — fast, consistent UI from ready grid and components.

entry.title: BuildBootstrap
entry.summary: Builds a Bootstrap layout visually and generates its code.

entry.title: Bulma
entry.summary: A modern framework built purely from CSS (no JavaScript), based on Flexbox. Unlike Bootstrap it ships no JS components — you take the classes and write your own interactions.

entry.title: Buttons Generator
entry.summary: Ready CSS button styles with their code for use in projects.

entry.title: Chart.js
entry.summary: A JavaScript library drawing simple, responsive charts on canvas. Unlike heavy visualisation libraries it is lightweight and works in a few lines.

entry.title: Colors and Fonts
entry.summary: A design resource pairing colour palettes with typography.

entry.title: Colors.lol
entry.summary: A repository of inspiring colour palettes.

entry.title: Cruip
entry.summary: Modern landing-page and UI templates (Tailwind-heavy).

entry.title: CSS Battle
entry.summary: A game where you reproduce a target image with as little CSS code as possible. Unlike tutorials it sharpens skill through competition and scoring.

entry.title: CSS Formatter
entry.summary: Un-minifies and formats CSS back into a readable shape.

entry.title: CSS Layout
entry.summary: Ready CSS recipes for common layouts and components (cards, centring, sticky header). Unlike searching it gives each pattern as a copyable, self-contained example.

entry.title: CSS Media Query Generator
entry.summary: Generates CSS media queries for specific device sizes.

entry.title: CSS Minifier
entry.summary: Minifies CSS by stripping whitespace to shrink it.

entry.title: CSS Reference
entry.summary: A reference showing every CSS property with a visual example. Unlike the spec it explains “what does this property do” with a live demo rather than text.

entry.title: DevSamples
entry.summary: Easy-to-use HTML, CSS and JavaScript code examples.

entry.title: Fancy Border-Radius
entry.summary: A visual tool that generates CSS border-radius for organic shapes.

entry.title: Flat UI Color Picker
entry.summary: An interactive palette of harmonious flat colours for frontends.

entry.title: Font Flipper
entry.summary: Tries and compares hundreds of Google fonts on your own design.

entry.title: FontPair
entry.summary: A tool showing Google font pairs that go well together. Unlike trying one by one it presents harmonious heading-body matches with examples.

entry.title: Framer
entry.summary: A design tool for building and publishing interactive interfaces and sites.

entry.title: FreeFrontEnd
entry.summary: A large directory of HTML, CSS and JavaScript code samples and tutorials.

entry.title: Frontend Focus
entry.summary: A newsletter rounding up frontend news, articles and tools weekly. Unlike scattered following it gives a single, filtered digest.

entry.title: Frontend Mentor
entry.summary: A practice platform that gives realistic design files and asks you to turn them into code. Unlike random projects it comes with professional designs and community feedback.

entry.title: Image Color Picker
entry.summary: Extracts colour codes and a palette from an image.
